rationale: Targeted check of the one prior blocking finding: CR-001 resolved. At HEAD fce5613f0, TestPersonalProjectGuard runs the real _reject_if_personal_project for assign, update and remove, covering unrelated-404, admin-403 and owner-403, and asserts no repo mutation and no activity event; the guard runs first in all three methods. The docstring now names that class. The .codemie/codemie-cli.config.json hunk is an unrelated, uncommitted user change and was not graded. Defer items from the final round are not re-checked.

Design 1: ProjectAssignmentService imported lazily inside the methods
business_review.notes: lazy import inside each of the three methods

business_review.notes: get_by_name None -> 404; tests assert get_or_create not called

business_review.item: Design 3: validation, guards and errors come from ProjectAssignmentService

business_review.notes: delegation only; PAS calls budget sync helpers and inserts USER_PROJECT_* events

business_review.item: Design 6 / Non-goals: PAS, routers, models, default endpoints, frontend unchanged

business_review.item: AC4: POST on missing project returns 404 and creates neither project nor membership

business_review.item: AC5: PUT records USER_PROJECT_ROLE_UPDATED via update_user_project_role

business_review.item: AC7: membership and budget mutations commit in one transaction; nothing committed on raise

business_review.item: AC8: ProjectAssignmentService and Projects-management routers unchanged and their tests still pass

business_review.item: AC9: UAS unit tests cover AC1-AC7: delegation args, 404 missing project, commit/invalidate ordering, no commit on raise
